description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957 Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with a global team. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core: Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. Bonus: Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. About the Team The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. Why Join Us Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry.   • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns.

raw.jobDescription:
Job Description

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineer for Devices/IoT to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as Consumer Electronics. We are looking for candidates who are accomplished Linux plumbers. If you are someone passionate about Linux, who knows the plumbing of the OS inside and out, who is proficient with distribution packaging, software design, system debugging, and bringing customer's ideas to life, then please keep on reading - this may be a uniquely exciting opportunity for you.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PC's. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity and footprint.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location: This role will be based remotely in Japan (preferably in Tokyo or Osaka area)

 What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Elaborate solutions to be proposed to prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience (Yocto, Buildroot...) or RTOS
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
  • For positions in Japan and Korea, the successful candidates will also be able to speak and write the local language at a professional level.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with customer engagements a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Backend leaning Software Engineer. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, high-performance systems. Leveraging JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, SQL and NoSQL cloud-native databases, and AWS, you will develop innovative solutions for user, group, and membership management while ensuring the highest levels of security and reliability.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Enable us to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable services that exceed industry standards and customer expectations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale projects with cross-team dependencies.
  • Collaborate with peer teams to deliver solutions that meet industry standards and customer expectations.
  • Maintain and operate services at high scale, participating in scheduled on-call rotations to ensure reliability.
  • Implement identity synchronization and lifecycle management solutions using SCIM and other relevant standards.
  • Work with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes, etc.) to deliver scalable, high-availability applications.
  • Build and maintain high-quality enterprise software using TypeScript, REST APIs, and JSON.

About You:

  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong knowledge of security architecture, LDAP, Active Directory, SAML, SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect and web protocols like XML, SOAP, JSON, and REST.
  • Familiarity with access control models such as RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC.
  • Experience with SQL.
  • Practical experience developing and improving applications written in Node.js.
  • Exhibit excellent problem-solving abilities and effective communication skills, especially when collaborating with diverse teams.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000-$294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

raw.jobDescription:
Why Polar?

It's never been easier to build, ship and scale software.

But it's never been harder to monetize it.

Modern startups look fundamentally different than prior generations:

  • Smaller teams

  • Exponential revenue growth relative to headcount

  • Higher variability in costs (LLMs) requiring more frequent pricing iterations

  • Laser focused on product development and distribution

  • Delegating and automating everything that is boilerplate – be it in their codebase or business operations.

Exceptional billing primitives, APIs and SDKs are essential, but delightful integration is not enough.

Startups need a billing platform designed for their speed of iteration. Combining billing and analytics in one platform to offer customer- and feature unit economics in real-time. Offering built-in pricing and cost insights, simulations and optimizations while simultaneously handling international compliance, tax management, fraud prevention and more.

That's Polar. We're building the next standard for applied AI startups.

Join our small, talented and engineering-led team across Europe as we build the infrastructure powering the next generation of software companies.

We focus on shipping at high velocity to serve startup founders scale their businesses. Everything else is secondary.

Product Engineering at Polar

Fullstack engineerings with a strong product sense and taste. As we grow, we'll gradually move towards more specialized roles between backend vs. frontend vs. product engineering. Therefore, we ask about your main strength in the application to ensure we maintain a strong & balanced team across the spectrum.

Our Stack

  • Frontend: React & Next.js with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, TanStack Router and more.

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI), Postgres, Redis, Dramatiq.

  • Cloud: Vercel, Render & AWS.

Always subject to change as we scale and new technologies emerge.

Role & responsibilities

We’re hiring exceptional Senior Product Engineers to join our growing remote-first team in Europe. You'll work across our entire stack to ship innovative features, enhancements and delights; obsessing over the developer experience and empowering them to scale their businesses. You're very comfortable jumping between frontend, backend, and infrastructure to autonomously identify, build, ship and scale features.

We don't have a lot of meetings, red tape or code reviews. We celebrate and optimize our organisation for shipping high-quality software fast – each engineer deploys countless times a day. So you'll be given a lot of agency and autonomy to move fast towards our mission and serving our developer community.

  • Ship daily towards building the best monetization platform for developers in the world.

  • Design, build, and ship features, enhancements and delights end-to-end – jumping between frontend, backend, and infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with the team on architecture design, best practices, and ensuring high-quality code across our stack.

  • Continuously improve the quality of services and the overall developer experience.

  • Engage frequently with our developer community to identify pain points and solve them.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience building, shipping and scaling high-quality software.

  • You ship fast and can solve any problem thrown at you end-to-end.

  • Strong proficiency with our stack or a variety of similar programming languages and ability + desire to quickly learn and pickup new tools.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities with an eye for developer experience.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and multi-cloud environments.

  • Excellent collaboration skills - comfortable working closely with a small, high-performing team. It's a startup so we all have to lean-in across the board to.

  • You care deeply about your craft - be it delightful animations, thoughtful edge-case handling, developer experience or performance optimizations.

  • (Bonus) You're an ex-founder/startup CTO, open source maintainer or indie hacker.

  • (Bonus) Experience working with payments, billing, or developer tools.

What we offer

  • Meaningful ownership: Small team & large surface area. You’ll directly influence how the company and platform scale.

  • Product-driven culture: We build to empower the next generation of software companies - and operate with the same builder mindset internally.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary and equity aligned with the impact of the role.

  • Exceptional team: Work with highly talented team members distributed across Europe.

  • Remote-first environment: Work from anywhere in Europe, with a home office setup budget available.

  • Annual team offsites: As the team is spread across Europe, we gather in person at least once a year to collaborate, plan, and spend time.

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage to support you and your family.

  • Parental leave: Paid parental leave aligned with the standards and regulations of your local jurisdiction.

How We Hire

Polar is a remote-first company, with team members across Europe, and our hiring process is fully remote via video calls and email.

Hiring Process

  1. Application Review: We review your application and previous work.

  2. Intro call: A short conversation with Birk (Founder and CEO) to learn more about you and give you a chance to learn more about Polar.

  3. Take-home Assignment: A practical exercise designed to reflect the kind of problems you would work on in the role.

  4. Assignment Review: We review your assignment and feedback together

  5. Team Conversations: 2-3 video calls where you get the chance to meet future team members.

  6. Offer

  7. Reference Calls

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data
description: About Dune Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more. We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards ‍♀️ If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains. Learn more about us: Dune's Vision Values and working at Dune About the role Data Foundation owns how blockchain data enters Dune, how it is represented and how it’s delivered externally. This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics. You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself. In this role you will Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade-offs Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early Drive high-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team You might be a great fit if You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern. You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop. You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team Not required, but a plus Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog Experience at a company where the data is the product Perks & Benefits A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings! Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ). On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days. An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk. Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet! And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag ! ✌️ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. #LI-Remote

This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will

  • Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade-offs

  • Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

  • Drive high-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production

  • Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

  • Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage

  • Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down

  • Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team

You might be a great fit if

  • You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces

  • You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern.

  • You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it

  • You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus

  • Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

  • A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

  • We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

  • On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

title: Fractional RevOps / GTM Engineer (Part-Time, Contract)
description: Anagram is the ultimate insurance billing platform for eye care providers. Combining instant eligibility and benefit verifications, patient responsibility calculation, claims management, payment posting, and more, Anagram's all-in-one revenue cycle management solution is designed to save providers time and money, and free doctors to deliver the best care for their patients. Our mission is to simplify insurance, and it's working: over 2,000 eye care professionals rely on Anagram to manage their insurance billing. Founded in 2014, Anagram is the largest and fastest-growing insurance billing platform for eye care providers in America and processes hundreds of millions of dollars each year. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer to own the revenue systems layer across a genuinely messy and interesting go-to-market. You'll design and maintain the pipes connecting CRM, billing, warehouse, and analytics, and wire AI into the workflows in between. You'll work directly with revenue leadership and have wide latitude in how things get built. Why This Role Is Harder Than It Sounds The account hierarchy is real. Our market spans solo practices, multi-location companies, roll-up brands, and PE platforms. The HubSpot company object has to do quadruple duty — PE firm → brand → company → location — with clean parent-child associations, dedup logic that respects the hierarchy, and reporting that rolls up correctly at every level. Four GTM motions run in parallel. SMB, mid-market, enterprise, and partner led — each needs its own routing, lifecycle logic, handoffs, and funnel reporting, without forking the CRM into four incompatible systems. Three products, three pricing models. Subscription, usage-based, and percentage-of-collections billing all flow through the same revenue stack. raw.jobDescription:
Anagram is the ultimate insurance billing platform for eye care providers. Combining instant eligibility and benefit verifications, patient responsibility calculation, claims management, payment posting, and more, Anagram's all-in-one revenue cycle management solution is designed to save providers time and money, and free doctors to deliver the best care for their patients. Our mission is to simplify insurance, and it's working: over 2,000 eye care professionals rely on Anagram to manage their insurance billing.

Founded in 2014, Anagram is the largest and fastest-growing insurance billing platform for eye care providers in America and processes hundreds of millions of dollars each year.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer to own the revenue systems layer across a genuinely messy and interesting go-to-market. You'll design and maintain the pipes connecting CRM, billing, warehouse, and analytics, and wire AI into the workflows in between. You'll work directly with revenue leadership and have wide latitude in how things get built.

Why This Role Is Harder Than It Sounds

  • The account hierarchy is real. Our market spans solo practices, multi-location companies, roll-up brands, and PE platforms. The HubSpot company object has to do quadruple duty — PE firm → brand → company → location — with clean parent-child associations, dedup logic that respects the hierarchy, and reporting that rolls up correctly at every level.

  • Four GTM motions run in parallel. SMB, mid-market, enterprise, and partner led — each needs its own routing, lifecycle logic, handoffs, and funnel reporting, without forking the CRM into four incompatible systems.

  • Three products, three pricing models. Subscription, usage-based, and percentage-of-collections billing all flow through the same revenue stack. Normalizing these into coherent ARR/NRR, cohort, and revenue reporting is a core design problem, not an afterthought.

About You

  • You're a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer with a builder profile.

  • Strong SQL from scratch.

  • You know when a Zap is enough and when it's time to write code.

  • Self-directed; comfortable operating fractionally with async communication and minimal oversight.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales/marketing ops with a builder profile

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience custom objects, associations, workflows, API —ideally with complex parent-child account structures (multi-location, franchise, healthcare, or roll-up environments)

  • Production experience with Stripe data, including usage-based or non-standard billing models

  • Production experience with Zapier

  • Practical experience building with Claude or comparable LLM APIs, prompting, evaluation, and knowing the failure modes

  • Self-directed; comfortable operating fractionally with async communication and minimal oversight

Nice-to-Haves

  • Healthcare or vertical SaaS experience; familiarity with provider data (NPI/NPPES, CMS datasets)

  • Experience supporting multiple concurrent GTM motions (PLG/SMB velocity alongside enterprise sales)

  • dbt and enrichment tooling (Apollo)

What You'll Do

  • CRM architecture (HubSpot): The parent-child company model, lifecycle stages, lead routing by segment, workflows, dedup, and data hygiene. You keep the CRM trustworthy so pipeline numbers are real at both the location and parent level.

  • Billing-to-CRM sync (Stripe): Reconcile heterogeneous billing data (subscription, usage, % of collections) with CRM records; surface churn, expansion, and payment signals where the revenue team can act on them.

  • Automation (Zapier + scripting): Build and maintain the integration layer. Know when a Zap is enough and when it's time to write code.

  • Data warehouse (Snowflake): Model GTM and revenue data into clean, queryable tables that handle the hierarchy and mixed pricing models. Strong SQL from scratch.

  • Analytics (Metabase): Dashboards leadership actually uses funnel conversion by motion, pipeline coverage, revenue normalized across pricing models, rollups by parent account.

  • AI workflows (Claude): Lead enrichment and scoring, call summarization, follow-up drafting, and data cleanup at scale, including provider-level enrichment from industry datasets (NPI/NPPES).

Anagram offers employees:

  • Industry-leading compensation, including salary and equity ownership

  • MacBook, monitor, and all the technologies you need to succeed

  • Full Medical & Dental Insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401k

  • Remote first company

  • Fast-paced startup environment

Anagram is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

A meticulous, detail-driven working style. Compliance work leaves little room for loose ends. A proactive approach to communication: comfortable clarifying requirements, flagging risk and escalating early rather than waiting to be asked. Cloud platforms such as AWS (Azure experience is also welcome) and message-based or asynchronous systems, such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus. Experience with, or interest in, AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similiar. Fluent English. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact. Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration. Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life. Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business. Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket . Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events. Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. title: Social Comms
description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. Please mention the word **AWARD** and tag RMjAuMTY5LjEwMi4w when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuMTY5LjEwMi4w). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications—leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS). You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori. Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations. Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations. Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects. Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations. Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP). Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability. Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations. Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility. Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications. title: Manager, Security Operations Center - EMEA
description: Headquarters: Remote Ireland Reports to: Director, Security Operations Center Location: Remote Ireland Compensation Range: €115,200 to €133,000 base plus bonus and equity What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. What You’ll Do: The Huntress Security Operations Center is a global team of security analysts dedicated to investigating and responding to incidents on our partners’ networks 24/7, 365 days a year. Daily activities consist of providing investigation, containment, and response actions across millions of endpoints. This role is accountable for defining and streamlining processes, workflows, and playbooks that enable effective day-to-day operations. As Huntress continues to grow, we are laser-focused on scaling our operations and force-multiplying our human analysts by 10X. This position is responsible for enabling analysts to meet our mission and achieve internal Service Level Objectives for response times. The Security Operations Manager will work with their peer regional managers to ensure consistent global operations while providing our analyst team with training opportunities and career growth. Compensation Range: €115,200 to €133,000 base plus bonus and equity

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

What You’ll Do: 

The Huntress Security Operations Center is a global team of security analysts dedicated to investigating and responding to incidents on our partners’ networks 24/7, 365 days a year. Daily activities consist of providing investigation, containment, and response actions across millions of endpoints.

This role is accountable for defining and streamlining processes, workflows, and playbooks that enable effective day-to-day operations. As Huntress continues to grow, we are laser-focused on scaling our operations and force-multiplying our human analysts by 10X. This position is responsible for enabling analysts to meet our mission and achieve internal Service Level Objectives for response times. The Security Operations Manager will work with their peer regional managers to ensure consistent global operations while providing our analyst team with training opportunities and career growth. 

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and enforce internal processes to reduce burnout and increase the productivity of the operations center against a global set of expectations and standards
  • Manage and enforce local/global shift coverage to ensure 24/7 operations are maintained 365 days a year
  • Meet with analysts in a 1:1 setting weekly to socialize focus initiatives, gather feedback, provide feedback, and enable analysts to progress rapidly in their career
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of analyst training programs designed to streamline onboarding and advance analyst skill sets in Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Malware Analysis, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Automation
  • Work with the Product organizations to prioritize the creation of new capabilities designed to augment and force multiple analyst capabilities
  • Maintain accountability for routine quality assurance for your designated region 
  • Engage with our Support organization to create streamlined workflows for partner/customer requests that need Security Operations Center analysis
  • Strengthen and mature our existing processes and relationships with our Tactical Response, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering teams within the Security organization
  • Provide one level of technical leadership for analysts of the Security Operations Center analysts
  • Ensure team members fully understand the goals and objectives of Huntress’ mission and how their work fits into the bigger picture
  • Provide key input and guidance to company stakeholders such as Marketing, Sales, Support, and Product
  • Develop, track, and report on Objectives and Key Results linked to Security Operations Center focus initiatives  
  • Help operationalize new technologies and services that Huntress brings to market
  • Participate in public speaking engagements in both webinar and in-person formats

What You Bring To The Team:

  • Experience in leading diverse cybersecurity teams with various skills. These teams work in Security Operations, Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Malware Analysis, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering
  • 5+ years of Security Analyst experience working in a global 24x7 security operations center with a focus on Windows forensics
  • 2+ year of team lead or managerial experience in a global operations center or Incident Response role. Preferably within a MSSP, MDR provider, or Incident Response service.
  • Actively engaged in the information security community by attending conferences or contributing to conversations/projects in the public domain
  • Continually learning and staying up to date on the latest threat actor tradecraft, detection techniques, and security operations concepts
  • Ability to identify workflows being performed and create detailed process diagrams and operating procedures
  • Effective communicator of highly technical concepts to stakeholders of varying technical backgrounds
  • Demonstrated experience leading initiatives or projects that required delegation and accountability to achieve success
  • Data-driven approach with experience in Data Science concepts

 

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set-up allowance (€480)
  • Generous personal leave entitlements
  • Digital monthly reimbursement (€111)
  • Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events
  • Pension
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

 

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are. 

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. 

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres. Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements. PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities. You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game. 
 Responsibilities Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability Requirements A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities Pluses Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration 
 $115,000 - $149,500 a year

raw.description:
You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed thatÂ you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe.

Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

  • You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

  • You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference betweenÂ a hook that's earnedÂ and a hook that's cheap.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, soÂ the outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

  • You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ taught in classrooms or workshops, orÂ you've created educational material.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

  • You've writtenÂ quiz or assessment questions.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. raw.title: Abnormal: Critical Situation Manager
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

The Critical Situation Manager owns the customer-facing response when a customer's trust in the platform has been shaken by a significant efficacy or product concern.  This role engages when a customer's feedback is substantive and requires a coordinated investigation and response from R&D and other technical teams. The Critical Situation Manager leads that investigation, translates technical findings into clear, confidence-restoring customer communication, and owns the engagement through to a formal resolution and close-out.

As a Critical Situation Manager, you are a skilled communicator who thrives at navigating complex customer challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and restoring customer confidence. You bring a strong customer-first mindset, the ability to untangle technical and relationship issues, and the confidence to drive action across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support. Your leadership and organizational skills will ensure that escalations are handled with urgency, transparency, and accountability.  You have held roles such as Support Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity environments, and this background enables you to navigate complex technical issues and customer relationships effectively.

The Critical Situation Manager will:

  • Serve as the customer-facing owner for high-stakes technical situations where a customer's confidence in the platform needs to be restored.
  • Assess incoming situations and determine the right level of response, from a clear explanation to a full cross-functional investigation.
  • Coordinate with R&D and other technical teams to investigate customer-reported concerns, translating customer feedback into a precise, actionable investigation request.
  • Translate technical findings back into clear, credible communication for customer stakeholders, up to and including executive audiences.
  • Own the full arc of each engagement following the initial assignment, from investigation through resolution, and a formal close-out with the customer.
  • Set and hold timeline expectations with customers throughout an engagement, ensuring no gaps in communication.
  • Track outcomes and findings across engagements to identify recurring themes and inform product and process improvements.
  • Build and drive the Critical Situation Management process and build playbooks for handling common scenarios

Must Haves

  • 5-7 years of customer-facing experience in a technical role (TAM, SE, Support, or related enterprise SaaS roles) with a proven track record in managing escalations
  • Sufficient technical fluency in Abnormal's detection architecture and investigation tooling to engage credibly with both R&D and customers without a technical translator.
  • Demonstrated success in leading de-escalations for complex, strategic customers, and strong judgment in assessing the right level of response to a customer concern
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle, support workflows, and escalation management best practices
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level communication with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Comfort owning complex, multi-week engagements through to resolution, not just leading an initial call.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple high-stakes issues simultaneously
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional trust quickly, including with technical teams outside your direct reporting line.
  • Empathy-driven, customer-first orientation with a bias for action
  • Experience in Cybersecurity is required

 

#LI-MC2

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives. The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections. Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites. Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance. Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant. Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.  $90,000 - $120,000 a year
